req.title: Return 404 for unknown squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 404 when no player has the requested squad number.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-005 requires HTTP 404 when no player has the requested squad number. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a known squad number returns 200 (to verify the happy path and ensure 404 is not returned spuriously), (2) a negative/EP case confirming a squad number that does not exist in the 26-row fixture returns exactly 404, (3) a BVA boundary case at squad number 0 (below the minimum seeded value of 1) which is absent from the DB and must return 404, (4) a BVA boundary case at squad number 27 (one above the maximum seeded value of 26) which is also absent and must return 404, and (5) a DT case using a large/arbitrary unknown squad number to confirm the 404 path is not gated on proximity to known values. All tests use exact status-code assertions to catch comparison-operator mutations (== vs !=, 404 vs 200, etc.).

tests.name: test_known_squad_number_returns_200
preconditions: Database contains exactly 26 pre-loaded rows with squadNumbers 1-26
trace: R-PLAYER-005 — positive control: a known squad number must NOT return 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_known_squad_number_returns_200():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Reddy'

test_known_squad_number_returns_200()
